summary: This bill amends the Public Health Service Act to make area career and technical education schools eligible for federal grants that support mental health and substance use disorder services for students, similar to existing eligibility for institutions of higher education.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands eligibility for mental health and substance use disorder service grants to include area career and technical education schools. This directly relates to providing healthcare services, specifically mental health, to a broader student population, thus leaning towards more public healthcare access.

The bill expands eligibility for federal mental health and substance use disorder grants to additional schools, which would increase federal spending on these priorities and thus tends to enlarge the deficit.

The entire bill amends the Public Health Service Act to extend government grant funding for mental health and substance use services to area career and technical education schools, directly constituting government action to expand coverage.
